name: Dimmed Glow
effect: Lux techniques used by this Enitoy deal 20% less damage, but have a 20% chance to raise evasion by 1 stage.

name: Faulty Filter
effect: Toxic techniques used by this Enitoy have a 20% boost but have a 20% chance to randomly poison this Enitoy, the opponent, or both.

name: Faulty Wire
effect: When This Enitoy attempts to use a physical technique, there is a 20% chance that it is unable to act and the technique fails. When this Enitoy is hit by a technique that makes contact, the attacker loses 5% of its MAX HP and has a 30% chance to become paralyzed.

name: Loose Debris
effect: When this Enitoy is hit by a contact technique, an entry hazard is setup on both sides of the field.

name: Loose Feathers
effect: When this Enitoy uses a contact technique or has a contact technique used against it, loose feathers coat the opponent, lowering the opponent's speed by 1 stage.

name: Poor Camouflage
effect: When this Enitoy enters battle, its evasion is lowered by 1 stage and Plant techniques used by this Enitoy have a 20% boost.

name: Over-Absorbent
effect: Hydro Techniques used by this Enitoy deal 20% less damage. When this Enitoy uses or hit by a Hydro technique, this Enitoy has both its defense and special defense raised by 1 stage and its speed lowered by 1 stage.

name: Overcharged
effect: Electro techniques use by this Enitoy have a 20% boost but deal 5% recoil to this Enitoy.

name: Overstuffed
effect: When this Enitoy enters battle, its defense is raised by 1stage and its speed is lowered by 1 stage. Whenever this Enitoy eats a berry, this Enitoy's speed is lowered by 1 stage and its defense if raised by 1 stage.

name: Runny Paint
effect: When this Enitoy uses a technique, before the technique is used this Enitoy coats itself in paint which changes it stitching to match the technique they are about to use.

name: Sleepless
effect: This Enitoy is unable to be put to sleep.

name: Slippery
effect: When this Enitoy enters battle they have their speed raised by 1 stage and their accuracy lowered by 1 stage. When this Enitoy uses or is hit by a Hydro technique their speed is raised by 1 stage and their accuracy is lowered by 1 stage.

name: Split Seam
effect: When this Enitoy is hit by a physical technique, there is a 20% chance its defense will be lowered by 1 stage and its speed will be raised by 1 stage.

name: Squeaky Speaker
effect: When this Enitoy uses an Audio technique, there is a 20% chance to randomly confuse this Enitoy, the opponent, or both for 2 to 5 turns.

name: Wobbly Balance
effect: When this Enitoy enters battle its speed stat is rasied by 1 stage, but all physical techniques used by it are 20% less accurate with a 10% boost.
